forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email. If it exists, we will send a password reset link, valid for 1 hour.
forgot.sent: If this email has a Sao Việt account, a password reset link has been sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password of at least 8 characters. All existing sessions will be signed out.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.tooShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.
reset.invalidToken: This password reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.error: Could not reset the password. Please try again.
reset.success: Password changed. You can now sign in with your new password.

admin.tempPasswordNote: Shown only once. Hand it to the user over a secure channel and ask them to change it right away.
admin.sessionsRevoked: All of this user's sessions were revoked.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset the password of your Sao Việt account. Use the button below to choose a new one. The link is valid for 1 hour.
reset.fallback: If the button does not work, open this link:
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your current password stays unchanged.

booking.subject: Booking confirmation {code}
booking.body: Thank you for booking with Sao Việt. Your booking is pending confirmation; we will contact you shortly.
booking.footer: Keep this code to look the booking up under Account.

orderStatus.subject: Booking {code}: {status}

body.confirmed: Sao Việt has confirmed your trip. See you under the stars!
body.completed: Thanks for travelling with Sao Việt. If you have a minute, please leave a review of the trip.
body.cancelled: Your booking has been cancelled. If this is a mistake, reply to this email or contact us.

orderStatus.footer: See the booking details in your Account page.

social.failed: Google sign-in didn't complete. Try again, or use email and password.

field.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
